segments.name: Automotive Finance
segments.description: Provides consumer and commercial automotive financing, including loans and operating leases, primarily through dealer relationships.
segments.evidence: Within our Automotive Finance operations, we are focused on enhancing our market-leading position and delivering long-term growth in annual originations by continuing to strengthen dealer engagement, deepen strategic partnerships, and evolve our expansion strategies, while maintaining an appropriate level of risk appetite.

segments.name: Insurance
segments.description: Offers automotive insurance products, including vehicle service contracts, through the dealer network.
segments.evidence: Within our Insurance operations, we seek to grow written premiums and deliver accretive returns by leveraging our automotive dealer network and driving efficiencies through process improvements and claims management, managing risk, and leveraging strategic reinsurance.

segments.name: Corporate Finance
segments.description: Provides senior secured leveraged cash flow loans and other financing to equity sponsors and middle-market companies.
segments.evidence: The Company also includes a seasoned corporate finance business that offers capital for equity sponsors and middle-market companies.

revenueModel.text: Ally earns interest and lease income on consumer and commercial loans and operating leases, insurance written premiums, and fee income from corporate finance lending and Ally Invest advisory and brokerage services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company serves customers with deposits and securities brokerage and investment advisory services as well as automotive financing and insurance offerings.
